findings.question: error-handling
findings.note: check-secret-leaks.mjs forwarded leak-check's raw stderr on the exit-2 fail-closed path; a zero-token ('effectively empty') secret value is echoed by leak-check via JSON.stringify, so the wrapper could print a secret value - a reachable counterexample to the gate's absolute 'never prints the value' claim. Narrow (a real high-entropy secret always yields >=1 token and takes the leak-compare path, never this branch). Fixed: the exit-2 branch now emits a fixed diagnostic naming only the file and the env-var NAME; child output is withheld. Reproduced before (leak-check echoes '%%%!!!---') and confirmed withheld after (wrapper prints only 'WEIRD', exit 2). No test change needed.

findings.question: over-engineering
findings.note: The directory walk is copy-pasted across the three wrappers (and mirrors check-upstream-manifest-integrity). ADR-0113 Option 2 (shared lib) was considered and rejected to keep each gate self-contained and dependency-free for per-skill genesis install, matching the existing gate/producer split. Justified; no action.

verdict: PASS after F1 fix. Matrix otherwise clean/cleared-with-evidence: no detection re-implemented (every wrapper spawns its single oracle), every wrapper fails closed on every input path, the secret gate keeps values off disk and off every path, the tests discriminate and forbid vacuous passes, and the manifest/integrity/ADR are consistent and honest.
